ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to validate Servicing Branch
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Opportunity', NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT(ISBLANK(Servicing_Branch__c)), OR(NOT(ISNUMBER(Servicing_Branch__c)), BEGINS(Servicing_Branch__c,'0')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Servicing Branch is a 4-digit number, and should not start with a zero.
